run_fuse_gtest: run the script to fuse Google Test source files into a single header and source file
run_fuse_gtest_with_root: run the script with a custom GTest root directory and output directory path
fuse_gtest_h: fuse all Google Test header files recursively into a single gtest.h output file
fuse_gtest_all_cc: fuse all Google Test C++ source files recursively into a single gtest-all.cc output file
validate_gtest_root_dir: validate that the given directory contains valid Google Test root seed files
